page_title: CLE 0-1 NIC | Clermont v Nice 27/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the right post.
90+2' Dangerous play by Grejohn Kyei (Clermont). Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Habib Keita (Clermont) picked up a rebound and unleashed a fine effort which crashed against the right post.
90' Clermont failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
88' The referee signals a substitution. Tom Louchet (Nice) is brought on as a substitute for Jeremie Boga.
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) coming on for Cheick Oumar Konate.
88' Pascal Gastien has decided to substitute Shamar Nicholson and he is replaced by Grejohn Kyei (Clermont).
86' The resulting set piece from Clermont is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
85' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) makes a strong challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul.
82' Substitution. Johan Gastien did his best and is replaced by Bilal Boutobba (Clermont).
80' Jeremie Boga (Nice) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
80' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Romain Perraud (Nice) but poses no threat.
79' Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jeremie Pignard saw the whole situation.
77' Nice can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
76' Pascal Gastien decides to make a substitution. Maxime Gonalons will be replaced by Habib Keita (Clermont).
75' It is time for a substitution. Elbasan Rashani (Clermont) is on for Muhammed Cham.
74' 0 - 1 Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.

72' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) receives a precise pass inside the box and drills a promising first-time blast towards the middle of the goal. His effort is blocked by Marcin Bulka who dives to keep the ball out. What a save!
71' Francesco Farioli has decided to make a change. Khephren Thuram (Nice) replaces Morgan Sanson.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aliou Balde (Nice) comes onto the pitch so that Evann Guessand can be given a rest.
69' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
67' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Nice, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
67' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jeremie Pignard blows for a foul. Nice win a free kick.
65' The ball is cleared after Evann Guessand (Nice) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
64' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Morgan Sanson (Nice) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
64' 3:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
61' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Romain Perraud (Nice) was quite harsh and Jeremie Pignard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
60' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Nice, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
60' Jeremie Pignard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Johan Gastien (Clermont) and blew his whistle. Nice are awarded the free kick.
58' It will be a substitution. Terem Moffi (Nice) is ready to enter the pitch as Gaetan Laborde walks off.

56' Great solo effort by Muhammed Cham (Clermont) as he tricks his way through the defence before firing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. Marcin Bulka is alert and denies him.
54' Cheick Oumar Konate (Clermont) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
52' Jeremie Boga (Nice) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Clermont will have a goal kick.
50' A snap shot from distance by Morgan Sanson (Nice) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
50' Nice try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
50' Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Nice have a free kick.
49' The free kick from long range, taken by Clermont, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

48' Morgan Sanson (Nice) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Clermont.
48' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) is able to continue to play.
47' Maxime Gonalons (Clermont) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
46' Francesco Farioli has made a change at the break. Romain Perraud (Nice) has come on in place of Melvin Bard.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Morgan Sanson (Nice) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
40' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) was too forceful with his tackle and Jeremie Pignard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
39' Pablo Rosario (Nice) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
37' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) doesn't keep his cool and fails to convert the penalty. He skies the ball way over the bar and into the stands.
36' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) is going to take the penalty!
36' Referee Jeremie Pignard awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
36' Referee Jeremie Pignard makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Nice. Let’s see what happens!
35' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
34' Ball possession – 34:66.
33' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.

30' What a poor attempt! Jeremie Boga (Nice) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes miles wide to the right.
30' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
28' Melvin Bard (Nice) brings his opponent down. Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Evann Guessand (Nice) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul.
25' Evann Guessand (Nice) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
25' Pablo Rosario (Nice) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
22' Johan Gastien (Clermont) commits a rough challenge and Jeremie Pignard blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Clermont are ruled offside.
18' Jim Allevinah (Clermont) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marcin Bulka intercepts the ball.
17' Nice take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
16' Melvin Bard (Nice) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Nice.
12' Wow, what an escape. Gaetan Laborde (Nice) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
10' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed shot towards the bottom right corner, but Mory Diaw pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
7' Mory Diaw displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Jeremie Boga (Nice) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
4' Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
2' Alidu Seidu (Clermont) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jeremie Pignard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Nice will kick-off.
Jeremie Pignard will officiate today.
